$comment: Entry schema for contributes.editorThemes (declarative and process plugins, manifest apiVersion 2). An entry is inline or a {"path"} reference to a JSON file under editor-themes/, themes/ or assets/. Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_editor_themes.go: colors must contain {{lists.requiredColors}} (opaque) and may use only the allowlisted Monaco color ids; rules are Monaco token rules. Contrast floors (translucent colors composited on editor.background): editor.foreground >= 4.5, every rule foreground >= 3.0 on its rule background or editor.background, editorCursor.foreground >= 3.0, editor.foreground on editor.selectionBackground >= 3.0. A theme that fails is skipped (install is refused). Themes cannot set fonts.
description: Editor color themes: Monaco colors and syntax token rules offered in Settings > General > Editor theme, independent of the UI theme.

id.description: <pluginId>.<name>; the stored setting names this id.

kind.description: Base Monaco theme: vs (light) or vs-dark (dark).

fontStyle.description: Space-separated subset of italic, bold, underline, strikethrough; empty resets.
